verdict.rationale: Publishing expected timelines is a fair question for an immigration law firm, but the evidence contains no published preparation time or government processing times. The only related item is a generic promise to 'start work for optimum turn around time' (docs-16), which is an adjacent service-responsiveness claim, not a published timeline.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
